question_en: On an unlaned road, where should you position your vehicle when driving?
question_zh: 在沒有車道標線的道路上行駛時，你的車輛應定位在哪裡？

options.en: In the centre of the road
options.zh: 在道路中央

options.en: As far to the left as is safe
options.zh: 盡量靠左且安全的位置

options.en: On the right-hand side so oncoming vehicles can see you
options.zh: 在右側，讓對向車輛能看到你

options.en: As close to the right edge as possible
options.zh: 盡量靠近右側邊緣

explanation_en: On an unlaned road you must drive as far to the left as is safe. This keeps oncoming traffic lanes clear and reduces the risk of head-on collisions.
explanation_zh: 在沒有車道標線的道路上，你必須盡量靠左且保持安全。這可以讓對向車道保持淨空，降低正面碰撞的風險。

question_en: When turning right, which lane must you turn into on the road you are entering?
question_zh: 右轉時，你必須轉入你進入道路的哪條車道？

options.en: The lane nearest to the left edge
options.zh: 最靠近左側邊緣的車道

options.en: The nearest lane on the left side of the centre line
options.zh: 中心線左側最近的車道

options.en: The rightmost available lane
options.zh: 最靠右的可用車道

options.en: Any available lane
options.zh: 任何可用車道

explanation_en: When turning right, you must turn into the nearest lane on the left side of the centre line of the road you are entering — not a lane further to the left.
explanation_zh: 右轉時，你必須轉入你進入道路的中心線左側最近的車道，而不是更左邊的車道。

question_en: What must you do before moving from the right-hand lane to the left-hand lane?
question_zh: 從右線移到左線之前，你必須怎麼做？

options.en: Sound your horn to warn other drivers
options.zh: 按喇叭警告其他駕駛

options.en: Signal left and check it is safe to change lanes
options.zh: 打左方向燈並確認換線安全

options.en: Flash your headlights first
options.zh: 先閃頭燈

options.en: No signal is required when moving left
options.zh: 向左移動時不需要打方向燈

explanation_en: Before changing from the right lane to the left lane, you must signal left and check that it is safe — check your mirrors and blind spots.
explanation_zh: 從右線移到左線之前，你必須打左方向燈並確認安全——檢查後視鏡和盲點。

question_en: You want to turn right at a roundabout. How should you approach and exit?
question_zh: 你想在圓環右轉，應如何進入和離開圓環？

options.en: Approach in any lane, signal left on exit only
options.zh: 任意車道進入，離開時打左方向燈即可

options.en: Approach in the right lane, signal right on entry, signal left before your exit
options.zh: 從右線進入，入口打右方向燈，在你的出口前打左方向燈

options.en: Approach in the left lane, signal left throughout
options.zh: 從左線進入，全程打左方向燈

options.en: No signals are needed at roundabouts when turning right
options.zh: 在圓環右轉不需要任何方向燈

explanation_en: To turn right at a roundabout, approach in the right lane and signal right on entry. When you have passed the exit before the one you want, signal left and exit.
explanation_zh: 在圓環右轉，應從右線進入並在入口打右方向燈。當你通過你想離開的出口前一個出口時，打左方向燈後離開。

question_en: Before turning left into a driveway, what should you especially check for?
question_zh: 左轉進入私家車道之前，你應特別注意什麼？

options.en: Oncoming vehicles in the right lane
options.zh: 右線的對向車輛

options.en: Cyclists between you and the kerb
options.zh: 你和路緣之間的自行車騎士

options.en: Pedestrians on the opposite footpath
options.zh: 對側人行道上的行人

options.en: Road signs on the left side
options.zh: 左側的道路標誌

explanation_en: Before turning left into a driveway, check for cyclists travelling between your vehicle and the kerb, as they may be hidden in your blind spot.
explanation_zh: 左轉進入私家車道前，要特別注意你的車輛和路緣之間是否有自行車騎士，因為他們可能在盲點內。

question_en: You are on a narrow country road and want to turn right, but there is an oncoming vehicle and traffic behind you. What should you do?
question_zh: 你在一條狹窄的鄉村道路上想要右轉，但有對向車輛和後方車流，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Cross the centre line to position early for the right turn
options.zh: 提前跨越中心線為右轉做好定位

options.en: Wait on your side of the road and do not cross the centre line until it is safe
options.zh: 在你這一側等候，在安全之前不要跨越中心線

options.en: Sound your horn and turn quickly
options.zh: 按喇叭後快速轉彎

options.en: Turn around and find an alternative route
options.zh: 掉頭尋找替代路線

explanation_en: On a narrow road, wait on your own side of the road until it is safe to cross the centre line and turn right. Do not risk a head-on collision.
explanation_zh: 在狹窄道路上，等候在你這一側的道路，直到安全後才跨越中心線右轉。不要冒正面碰撞的風險。

question_en: When turning left, which lane must you turn into on the road you are entering?
question_zh: 左轉時，你必須轉入你進入道路的哪條車道？

options.en: The rightmost available lane
options.zh: 最靠右的可用車道

options.en: Any available lane
options.zh: 任何可用車道

options.en: The leftmost lane of the road you are turning into
options.zh: 你轉入道路的最左側車道

options.en: The nearest lane to the centre line
options.zh: 最靠近中心線的車道

explanation_en: When turning left, you must turn into the leftmost lane of the road you are entering, keeping well to the left.
explanation_zh: 左轉時，你必須轉入你進入道路的最左側車道，保持靠左行駛。

question_en: You want to turn right from a main road into a side street. May you stop in the flush median and wait for a gap in traffic?
question_zh: 你想從主幹道右轉進入小巷。你可以停在中央導引島內等待車流間隙嗎？

options.en: No — flush medians must never be used to wait
options.zh: 不行——導引島絕不能用來等候

options.en: Yes, if you can fit your vehicle safely within the flush median
options.zh: 可以，若你的車輛可以安全地停在導引島範圍內

options.en: Only if there is a sign allowing it
options.zh: 只有在有號誌允許時

options.en: Only for motorcycles, not cars
options.zh: 只有摩托車可以，汽車不行

explanation_en: You may use a flush median to wait when turning right, as long as your vehicle fits completely within the median and does not block traffic in either direction.
explanation_zh: 右轉時，若你的車輛能完全停在導引島範圍內且不阻礙任何方向的車流，你可以在導引島內等候。

question_en: Can a car stop in a cycle lane while waiting to turn left?
question_zh: 汽車等候左轉時可以停在自行車道上嗎？

options.en: Yes, but only briefly while waiting to turn
options.zh: 可以，但只能短暫等候轉彎

options.en: Yes, if there are no cyclists present
options.zh: 可以，若沒有自行車騎士在場

options.en: No, vehicles must not block the cycle lane
options.zh: 不行，車輛不得阻擋自行車道

options.en: Yes, as long as hazard lights are on
options.zh: 可以，只要開啟危險警示燈

explanation_en: A car must not stop in a cycle lane even while waiting to turn. Blocking the cycle lane puts cyclists at risk.
explanation_zh: 即使在等候轉彎，汽車也不得停在自行車道上。阻擋自行車道會使自行車騎士面臨危險。

question_en: You are over 20 years old. What is the legal blood alcohol limit for driving?
question_zh: 你已年滿20歲，駕車時合法的血液酒精濃度上限為何？

options.en: 30 mg per 100 ml of blood
options.zh: 每100毫升血液中30毫克

options.en: 50 mg per 100 ml of blood
options.zh: 每100毫升血液中50毫克

options.en: 80 mg per 100 ml of blood
options.zh: 每100毫升血液中80毫克

options.en: 100 mg per 100 ml of blood
options.zh: 每100毫升血液中100毫克

explanation_en: For drivers aged 20 and over, the legal blood alcohol limit is 50 mg per 100 ml of blood (or 250 mcg per litre of breath). Driving above this limit is a serious offence.
explanation_zh: 20歲及以上的駕駛，合法血液酒精濃度上限為每100毫升血液中50毫克（或每升呼氣250微克）。超過此上限駕車是嚴重違法行為。

question_en: Is it legal to use a hand-held mobile phone while driving?
question_zh: 邊開車邊使用手持手機是否合法？

options.en: Yes, as long as you are not texting
options.zh: 是的，只要你不在發短訊就可以

options.en: Yes, but only at speeds below 50 km/h
options.zh: 是的，但只有在時速50公里以下才可以

options.en: No, it is illegal to hold or use a mobile phone while driving
options.zh: 不，邊開車邊手持或使用手機是違法的

options.en: Yes, as long as you are stopped at traffic lights
options.zh: 是的，只要你在交通號誌前停車就可以

explanation_en: It is illegal to hold or use a hand-held mobile phone while driving, including when stopped at traffic lights. You may only use a phone hands-free.
explanation_zh: 邊開車邊手持或使用手機是違法的，包括在交通號誌前停車時。你只可以使用免持方式使用電話。

question_en: What are the signs that you are too tired to drive safely?
question_zh: 哪些跡象表明你太疲勞而無法安全駕駛？

options.en: You feel fully alert but drive a little faster than normal
options.zh: 你感覺完全清醒但行駛速度稍快

options.en: Heavy eyelids, difficulty concentrating, drifting in your lane, or missing road signs
options.zh: 眼皮沉重、注意力難以集中、在車道內飄移，或錯過道路標誌

options.en: You are slightly hungry
options.zh: 你稍微感到飢餓

options.en: You feel cold inside the car
options.zh: 你在車內感到寒冷

explanation_en: Signs of fatigue include heavy eyelids, difficulty concentrating, drifting in your lane, missing exits or road signs, and yawning frequently. If any of these occur, stop and rest.
explanation_zh: 疲勞的跡象包括眼皮沉重、注意力難以集中、在車道內飄移、錯過出口或道路標誌，以及頻繁打哈欠。一旦出現這些情況，應停車休息。

question_en: Another driver is behaving aggressively toward you on the road. What should you do?
question_zh: 另一位駕駛在路上對你表現出攻擊性行為，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Match their aggression so they know you are not intimidated
options.zh: 以攻擊性回應，讓對方知道你不會被嚇倒

options.en: Brake-check them to show you are aware of them
options.zh: 急煞一下讓他們知道你注意到了

options.en: Avoid eye contact, do not react, and keep a safe distance
options.zh: 避免眼神接觸，不要有所回應，保持安全距離

options.en: Speed up to get away from them as fast as possible
options.zh: 加速盡快擺脫對方

explanation_en: If another driver is being aggressive, do not react or retaliate. Avoid eye contact, stay calm, keep a safe distance, and if necessary pull over in a safe public place.
explanation_zh: 若另一位駕駛有攻擊性行為，不要回應或報復。避免眼神接觸，保持冷靜，保持安全距離，如有必要在安全的公共場所靠邊停車。

question_en: Must all passengers in a vehicle wear a seatbelt?
question_zh: 車輛內所有乘客都必須繫安全帶嗎？

options.en: Only the driver and front-seat passengers
options.zh: 只有駕駛和前座乘客

options.en: Yes — all passengers must wear a seatbelt
options.zh: 是的——所有乘客都必須繫安全帶

options.en: Only on motorways and open roads
options.zh: 只有在快速道路和開放道路上

options.en: Only children under 15
options.zh: 只有15歲以下的兒童

explanation_en: All occupants of a vehicle must wear a seatbelt or approved restraint. This applies to all seats and all roads.
explanation_zh: 車輛內所有乘客都必須繫安全帶或使用核准的安全裝置，適用於所有座位和所有道路。

question_en: What is the speed limit in a school zone when school speed limit signs are displayed or children are present?
question_zh: 當學校速限號誌顯示或有兒童在場時，學校區域的速限是多少？

options.en: 30 km/h
options.zh: 時速30公里

options.en: 50 km/h
options.zh: 時速50公里

options.en: 40 km/h
options.zh: 時速40公里

options.en: 20 km/h
options.zh: 時速20公里

explanation_en: The speed limit in a school zone is 40 km/h when the school speed limit signs are displayed or when children are present near the road.
explanation_zh: 當學校速限號誌顯示或有兒童在路旁時，學校區域的速限為時速40公里。

question_en: A pedestrian is crossing the road ahead of you at a pedestrian crossing. What must you do?
question_zh: 一名行人在你前方的行人穿越道過馬路，你必須怎麼做？

options.en: Sound your horn and continue at the same speed
options.zh: 按喇叭並維持車速繼續行駛

options.en: Give way to the pedestrian
options.zh: 禮讓行人

options.en: Flash your lights and slow down but do not stop
options.zh: 閃燈並減速但不停車

options.en: Proceed if you can pass behind them safely
options.zh: 若可以安全地從他們身後通過，繼續行駛

explanation_en: You must always give way to pedestrians on a pedestrian crossing. Stop and wait until they have completely crossed.
explanation_zh: 你必須永遠禮讓行人穿越道上的行人。停車等候，直到他們完全穿越。

question_en: When is it illegal to overtake another vehicle?
question_zh: 在什麼情況下超越另一輛車輛是違法的？

options.en: Only at night
options.zh: 只有在夜間

options.en: When you are on a road with a solid yellow centre line on your side, or it is otherwise unsafe
options.zh: 當你這一側的中心線為實線黃色標線，或其他不安全情況

options.en: Only on motorways
options.zh: 只有在快速道路上

options.en: Never — overtaking is always legal if you signal first
options.zh: 永遠不會——只要先打燈超車就永遠合法

explanation_en: Overtaking is illegal when there is a solid yellow centre line on your side, when you are approaching a crest, curve, intersection, or pedestrian crossing, or whenever it is unsafe to do so.
explanation_zh: 當你這一側的中心線為實線黃色標線，或當你接近山頂、彎道、路口或行人穿越道，或任何不安全的情況時，超車是違法的。

question_en: What is NOT allowed on a motorway?
question_zh: 快速道路上不允許什麼行為？

options.en: Driving at the speed limit
options.zh: 以速限行駛

options.en: Using the left lane when it is clear
options.zh: 在淨空時使用左線

options.en: Making a U-turn or reversing
options.zh: 掉頭或倒車

options.en: Overtaking on the right
options.zh: 從右側超車

explanation_en: On a motorway you must not make a U-turn, reverse, or drive the wrong way. Motorways are one-way and have no U-turn points.
explanation_zh: 在快速道路上，你不得掉頭、倒車或逆向行駛。快速道路是單向的，沒有掉頭點。

question_en: Before changing lanes, what must you always do?
question_zh: 在換車道之前，你必須始終做什麼？

options.en: Sound your horn to warn other drivers
options.zh: 按喇叭警告其他駕駛

options.en: Signal, check mirrors and blind spots, and make sure it is safe
options.zh: 打方向燈、檢查後視鏡和盲點，並確認安全

options.en: Flash your headlights
options.zh: 閃頭燈

options.en: Slow to below 50 km/h first
options.zh: 先減速至時速50公里以下

explanation_en: Before changing lanes, you must signal, check your mirrors and blind spots, and confirm it is safe. Failing to check blind spots is a common cause of lane-change crashes.
explanation_zh: 換車道前，你必須打方向燈、檢查後視鏡和盲點，並確認安全。未檢查盲點是車道變換事故的常見原因。

question_en: Is it legal to drive after taking medication that causes drowsiness?
question_zh: 服用會導致嗜睡的藥物後駕車是否合法？

options.en: Yes, as long as you feel alert
options.zh: 是的，只要你感覺清醒就可以

options.en: Yes, but only for short distances
options.zh: 是的，但只能短距離行駛

options.en: No, driving while impaired by any medication is illegal and dangerous
options.zh: 不，在任何藥物影響下駕車都是違法且危險的

options.en: Yes, if a doctor prescribes the medication
options.zh: 是的，如果是醫生處方的藥物就可以

explanation_en: Driving while impaired by medication is illegal and dangerous. If medication causes drowsiness or affects your ability to drive, do not drive — get advice from a doctor or pharmacist.
explanation_zh: 在藥物影響下駕車是違法且危險的。若藥物導致嗜睡或影響你的駕駛能力，不要駕車——向醫生或藥劑師諮詢。

question_en: What is the safest way to deal with fatigue on a long drive?
question_zh: 長途行駛中應對疲勞最安全的方式是什麼？

options.en: Open the window and turn up the radio
options.zh: 打開車窗並調大收音機音量

options.en: Drink energy drinks and keep driving
options.zh: 喝能量飲料後繼續行駛

options.en: Plan regular rest stops, take a nap if needed, and share driving if possible
options.zh: 規劃定期休息站，必要時小睡，盡可能輪流駕駛

options.en: Increase your speed to arrive faster
options.zh: 加速以更快抵達目的地

explanation_en: The safest way to deal with fatigue on long trips is to plan regular rest stops (every 2 hours), take a 15-20 minute nap if needed, and share the driving where possible.
explanation_zh: 長途行駛中應對疲勞最安全的方式是規劃定期休息站（每2小時一次）、必要時小睡15到20分鐘，並在可能的情況下輪流駕駛。

question_en: You want to overtake a vehicle on a two-lane road. What must you check before pulling out?
question_zh: 你想在雙線道路上超越一輛車輛，駛出前必須確認什麼？

options.en: That the road is straight for at least 50 metres
options.zh: 道路在至少50公尺內是筆直的

options.en: That you have enough room to complete the overtake safely and return to your lane
options.zh: 你有足夠的空間安全完成超車並回到你的車道

options.en: That the vehicle ahead is travelling at least 20 km/h below the speed limit
options.zh: 前方車輛行駛速度至少低於速限20公里

options.en: That the vehicle behind you is also overtaking
options.zh: 你後方的車輛也在超車

explanation_en: Before overtaking, check that you have enough clear road ahead to complete the manoeuvre and return to your lane before any oncoming traffic reaches you.
explanation_zh: 超車前，確認前方有足夠的淨空道路讓你完成超車並在對向車輛到達前回到你的車道。

question_en: What is the correct action when you want to enter a motorway from an on-ramp?
question_zh: 當你想從匝道進入快速道路時，正確的行動是什麼？

options.en: Stop at the bottom of the ramp and wait for a gap
options.zh: 在匝道底部停車等待間隙

options.en: Accelerate on the ramp to match motorway speed and merge when safe
options.zh: 在匝道上加速配合快速道路速度，安全時合流

options.en: Enter at any speed and let motorway vehicles give way to you
options.zh: 以任何速度進入，讓快速道路上的車輛禮讓你

options.en: Stay in the left lane of the motorway until you need to exit
options.zh: 在快速道路的左線保持行駛直到你需要出口

explanation_en: When entering a motorway, use the on-ramp to build up your speed to match motorway traffic, then merge safely into the left lane when there is a gap.
explanation_zh: 進入快速道路時，使用匝道加速至快速道路車流速度，然後在有間隙時安全合流至左線。

question_en: Is it legal to use a hands-free phone while driving?
question_zh: 邊開車邊使用免持電話是否合法？

options.en: No, all phone use is prohibited while driving
options.zh: 不，開車時完全禁止使用電話

options.en: Yes, using a phone hands-free is permitted while driving
options.zh: 是的，開車時允許使用免持方式使用電話

options.en: Only on motorways where there are no distractions
options.zh: 只有在沒有其他干擾的快速道路上

options.en: Only if the vehicle is stopped
options.zh: 只有在車輛停止時

explanation_en: Using a phone hands-free (e.g. via Bluetooth or a cradle) is permitted while driving. However, you must still drive safely and not be distracted.
explanation_zh: 使用免持方式使用電話（例如透過藍牙或支架）在開車時是允許的。但是，你仍必須安全駕駛，不得分心。

question_en: At an uncontrolled intersection (no signs or signals), who must you give way to?
question_zh: 在無管制路口（無號誌或標誌），你必須禮讓誰？

options.en: Vehicles approaching from your left
options.zh: 從你左側接近的車輛

options.en: Vehicles approaching from your right
options.zh: 從你右側接近的車輛

options.en: Vehicles travelling faster than you
options.zh: 行駛速度比你快的車輛

options.en: No one — the first to arrive goes first
options.zh: 無需禮讓任何人——先到先行

explanation_en: At an uncontrolled intersection, you must give way to any vehicle approaching from your right.
explanation_zh: 在無管制路口，你必須禮讓任何從你右側接近的車輛。

question_en: What does a red traffic light require you to do?
question_zh: 紅色交通號誌燈要求你做什麼？

options.en: Slow down and proceed with caution
options.zh: 減速並謹慎通行

options.en: Stop and give way, then proceed if clear
options.zh: 停車禮讓後，若淨空就通行

options.en: Stop completely behind the stop line and wait for green
options.zh: 在停止線後完全停車，等候綠燈

options.en: Stop only if other vehicles are present
options.zh: 只有在有其他車輛時才停車

explanation_en: A red light means stop completely behind the stop line and wait until the light turns green before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 紅燈表示在停止線後完全停車，等候燈號變為綠色後才能通行。

question_en: At a roundabout, what is the key give-way rule?
question_zh: 在圓環，最重要的禮讓規則是什麼？

options.en: Give way to vehicles entering the roundabout from the left
options.zh: 禮讓從左側進入圓環的車輛

options.en: Give way to vehicles already in the roundabout (from your right)
options.zh: 禮讓已在圓環內的車輛（從你右側來的）

options.en: The first vehicle to arrive at the roundabout has priority
options.zh: 最先抵達圓環的車輛有優先路權

options.en: Large vehicles always have right of way at roundabouts
options.zh: 大型車輛在圓環永遠享有優先路權

explanation_en: At a roundabout you must give way to any vehicles already in the roundabout — they come from your right in New Zealand.
explanation_zh: 在圓環，你必須禮讓已在圓環內的車輛——在紐西蘭，這些車輛從你的右側行駛過來。

question_en: What is the difference between a stop sign and a give-way sign at an intersection?
question_zh: 在路口，停車號誌和禮讓號誌有什麼區別？

options.en: Stop signs require a complete stop; give-way signs require slowing but not always stopping
options.zh: 停車號誌要求完全停車；禮讓號誌要求減速但不一定停車

options.en: There is no difference — both mean give way
options.zh: 沒有區別——兩者都表示禮讓

options.en: Give-way signs require a full stop; stop signs only require slowing
options.zh: 禮讓號誌要求完全停車；停車號誌只需減速

options.en: Stop signs are only for trucks; give-way signs are for cars
options.zh: 停車號誌只針對卡車；禮讓號誌針對汽車

explanation_en: A stop sign requires a complete stop at the line every time, regardless of whether traffic is present. A give-way sign requires you to slow down and be ready to stop, but you may proceed without stopping if the way is clear.
explanation_zh: 停車號誌每次都要求在停止線前完全停車，不論是否有車輛。禮讓號誌要求你減速並準備好停車，但如果路況淨空可以不停車直接通行。

question_en: You are turning right at an intersection. A vehicle is approaching from the opposite direction also turning right. Where should you position your vehicles to pass each other?
question_zh: 你在路口右轉，對向一輛車輛也正在右轉。兩輛車應如何互相通過？

options.en: Pass right side to right side (offside to offside)
options.zh: 右側對右側通過（外側對外側）

options.en: Pass left side to left side (nearside to nearside)
options.zh: 左側對左側通過（內側對內側）

options.en: One vehicle should wait while the other completes the turn
options.zh: 一輛車應等候另一輛完成轉彎

options.en: Pass on whichever side has more room
options.zh: 從有更多空間的一側通過

explanation_en: When two vehicles are both turning right at an intersection, the safest method is to pass right side to right side (offside to offside), keeping other traffic in view.
explanation_zh: 當兩輛車在路口都右轉時，最安全的方法是右側對右側（外側對外側）通過，保持其他車流在視線範圍內。

question_en: You are approaching an intersection where another vehicle is already in the intersection. What must you do?
question_zh: 你正接近一個路口，另一輛車已在路口內，你必須怎麼做？

options.en: Sound your horn and proceed
options.zh: 按喇叭後繼續通行

options.en: Give way to the vehicle that is already in the intersection
options.zh: 禮讓已在路口內的車輛

options.en: Proceed — you have right of way as the approaching vehicle
options.zh: 繼續通行——作為接近的車輛你享有優先路權

options.en: Stop and wait for a police officer to direct traffic
options.zh: 停車等候警察指揮交通

explanation_en: You must always give way to any vehicle already in the intersection, regardless of what signs are present.
explanation_zh: 你必須永遠禮讓已在路口內的車輛，不論有什麼標誌。

question_en: Two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, one from each side. Who gives way?
question_zh: 兩輛車同時從兩側抵達無管制路口，誰必須禮讓？

options.en: The vehicle on the left must give way to the vehicle on the right
options.zh: 左側的車輛必須禮讓右側的車輛

options.en: The vehicle on the right must give way to the vehicle on the left
options.zh: 右側的車輛必須禮讓左側的車輛

options.en: The smaller vehicle gives way to the larger one
options.zh: 較小的車輛禮讓較大的車輛

options.en: Both vehicles must stop and then the faster one goes first
options.zh: 兩輛車都必須停車，然後較快的先行

explanation_en: At an uncontrolled intersection, the vehicle on the left must give way to the vehicle on the right. This is the fundamental give-way rule in New Zealand.
explanation_zh: 在無管制路口，左側的車輛必須禮讓右側的車輛。這是紐西蘭最基本的禮讓規則。

question_en: You are turning left at a green traffic light. Who must you give way to?
question_zh: 綠燈時你左轉，你必須禮讓誰？

options.en: No one — turning left at green gives you priority
options.zh: 無需禮讓任何人——綠燈左轉享有優先路權

options.en: Pedestrians crossing the road you are turning into
options.zh: 正在穿越你轉入道路的行人

options.en: Only cyclists in the cycle lane
options.zh: 只需禮讓自行車道中的自行車騎士

options.en: Oncoming vehicles going straight through
options.zh: 直行的對向車輛

explanation_en: When turning left at a green light, you must give way to pedestrians crossing the road you are turning into.
explanation_zh: 綠燈左轉時，你必須禮讓正在穿越你轉入道路的行人。

question_en: What does a flashing yellow traffic light at an intersection mean?
question_zh: 路口的黃色閃爍交通號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Stop and wait for the green light
options.zh: 停車等候綠燈

options.en: The intersection is closed
options.zh: 路口已關閉

options.en: Proceed at normal speed — the intersection is clear
options.zh: 以正常速度通行——路口淨空

options.en: Proceed with caution and give way as required
options.zh: 謹慎通行並依規定禮讓

explanation_en: A flashing yellow light means the signal is not operating normally. Treat it as a give-way situation: slow down, proceed with caution, and give way as required.
explanation_zh: 黃色閃爍號誌表示號誌系統工作異常。將其視為禮讓情況：減速、謹慎通行，並依規定禮讓。

question_en: You are travelling straight ahead on a main road. A vehicle is emerging from a side road on your left. Who has right of way?
question_zh: 你在主幹道直行，左側有一輛車從側路駛出，誰享有優先路權？

options.en: The vehicle on the side road, because it is joining traffic
options.zh: 側路上的車輛，因為它正在加入車流

options.en: You on the main road, because you are travelling straight ahead
options.zh: 你在主幹道上，因為你在直行

options.en: Whichever vehicle is larger
options.zh: 較大的車輛

options.en: Both must stop and negotiate
options.zh: 兩者都必須停車協商

explanation_en: You on the main road have right of way. The vehicle emerging from the side road must give way to traffic on the main road.
explanation_zh: 你在主幹道上享有優先路權。從側路駛出的車輛必須禮讓主幹道上的車流。

question_en: When merging on a motorway (two lanes becoming one), who must give way?
question_zh: 在快速道路上合流（兩線合為一線）時，誰必須禮讓？

options.en: The vehicle in the continuing lane must give way to the merging vehicle
options.zh: 繼續車道的車輛必須禮讓合流車輛

options.en: The vehicle merging must give way to vehicles in the continuing lane
options.zh: 合流車輛必須禮讓繼續車道的車輛

options.en: Whichever vehicle is faster has right of way
options.zh: 行駛速度較快的車輛享有優先路權

options.en: Both vehicles must stop and take turns
options.zh: 兩輛車都必須停車輪流通行

explanation_en: When merging, the vehicle that is merging must give way to vehicles already in the lane they are merging into.
explanation_zh: 合流時，合流車輛必須禮讓已在其要進入車道的車輛。

question_en: At a T-intersection, the vehicle on the terminating road wants to turn right. Who must it give way to?
question_zh: 在T形路口，終止路上的車輛想要右轉，它必須禮讓誰？

options.en: Only vehicles coming from the right on the through road
options.zh: 只需禮讓貫通道路右側來的車輛

options.en: Only vehicles coming from the left on the through road
options.zh: 只需禮讓貫通道路左側來的車輛

options.en: All vehicles on the through road in both directions
options.zh: 貫通道路兩個方向的所有車輛

options.en: No one — T-intersections give priority to turning vehicles
options.zh: 無需禮讓任何人——T形路口給予轉彎車輛優先路權

explanation_en: At a T-intersection, the vehicle on the terminating road must give way to all traffic on the through road in both directions before turning or crossing.
explanation_zh: 在T形路口，終止路上的車輛在轉彎或穿越前，必須禮讓貫通道路兩個方向的所有車流。

question_en: You arrive at a stop sign at an intersection. When must you stop?
question_zh: 你在路口抵達停車號誌。你什麼時候必須停車？

options.en: Only when another vehicle is approaching
options.zh: 只有在另一輛車輛接近時

options.en: Every time, regardless of whether any traffic is present
options.zh: 每次都要停，不論是否有車輛在場

options.en: Only if you intend to turn — not if going straight
options.zh: 只有在打算轉彎時——直行不需要

options.en: Only at night
options.zh: 只有在夜間

explanation_en: At a stop sign you must make a complete stop every time, whether or not there is other traffic present. Failing to stop is an offence.
explanation_zh: 在停車號誌前，每次都必須完全停車，不論是否有其他車輛在場。未停車是違法行為。

question_en: You are on a road that has no signs or markings at an intersection with another road of similar size. A vehicle approaches from your right. What must you do?
question_zh: 你在一條沒有號誌或標線的道路上，與另一條類似大小的道路交叉。一輛車輛從你右側接近，你必須怎麼做？

options.en: Sound your horn and proceed first
options.zh: 按喇叭後先行通過

options.en: Give way to the vehicle on your right
options.zh: 禮讓你右側的車輛

options.en: The vehicle on your right must give way to you
options.zh: 你右側的車輛必須禮讓你

options.en: Both vehicles should stop and flash lights
options.zh: 兩輛車都應該停車並閃燈

explanation_en: At an uncontrolled intersection, you must give way to vehicles approaching from your right. This is the basic give-way rule.
explanation_zh: 在無管制路口，你必須禮讓從你右側接近的車輛。這是基本的禮讓規則。

question_en: When is it safe to enter an intersection?
question_zh: 何時進入路口是安全的？

options.en: As soon as the light turns green
options.zh: 一旦號誌變為綠色

options.en: Whenever you are in a hurry
options.zh: 任何你趕時間的時候

options.en: When you have given way to all traffic that has priority and there is a safe gap
options.zh: 當你已禮讓所有享有優先路權的車流，且有安全間隙時

options.en: When no vehicles are visible ahead
options.zh: 當前方看不到任何車輛時

explanation_en: It is safe to enter an intersection only after you have given way to all traffic with priority and there is a safe enough gap to complete your manoeuvre.
explanation_zh: 只有在禮讓所有享有優先路權的車流，且有足夠安全的間隙完成你的行駛動作後，進入路口才是安全的。
